page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8a.48xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal server instance within the ECS Bare Metal family, operating with a KVM hypervisor. The host is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 192 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 768.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 resource ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying entirely on network-attached block storage architectures.

Network infrastructure for this instance features a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating substantial throughput for inter-node communication and data ingestion. Because this bare-metal platform offers dedicated physical compute allocations without hardware-level GPU accelerators or bundled local disks, applications must balance large-scale parallel processing demands against external storage latencies. Cost efficiency is driven primarily by extreme compute density, offering a high aggregation of cores and memory on a single physical host without hypervisor contention.

This hardware footprint fits large-scale enterprise applications, high-concurrency container clusters, extensive in-memory caching solutions, large transactional databases, and distributed ETL pipelines requiring expansive compute capacity and consistent networking performance.
